name: Chain name
twoHopHint: Traffic goes through the front node, then the landing node. The landing provides the exit IP.
needNodes: Import at least two nodes in the current profile or the manual node pool to build a chain.
pluginPending: Plugin settings will appear here when plugin binding is available.
saveBeforeTest: Save changes before testing or applying this chain.
exitPrivacy: Runs only when requested, through this chain. No node credentials, subscription URLs or user identifiers are sent.
exitWarning: Exit-IP detection failed. The current route was kept.
exitSwitched: The fallback was verified and selected.
activated: The policy group now uses this chain.
activatedSession: The group switched for this session. Its selection could not be saved.
failed: The operation could not be completed ({{code}}).
empty: No saved chains in this profile.
hopsHint: A chain has 2 to 6 hops. Each hop is a node or a pool. Traffic dials through the hops in order.
adjacentHops: Two adjacent hops cannot be the same node.
poolEmpty: A pool groups nodes so a hop uses whichever member currently responds best.
appRouteHint: A route sends the traffic of the listed processes through a chain, a direct connection, or a rejection. Routes take priority over the profile's rules. Process names match the executable name; paths must be absolute.
exitDrift: The exit address is {{observed}}, not the pinned {{pinned}}.
historyEmpty: No samples yet. Run a test or an exit check.
appNameserverHint: A DoH address such as https://dns.example/dns-query, or an IP address.
appDomainScope: Domain rules apply to every application that resolves these domains. They cannot separate one application from another.

quality.note: Runs only when you start it. Sends real traffic through this chain, up to 20 MB and 60 seconds.
quality.confirm: This sends about {{size}} MB of traffic through the chain and takes up to a minute. Continue?
quality.failedRun: The quality test could not run through this chain.

poolScores.hint: Best first. Score is lower-is-better: latency and recent failures.

poolPolicy.applyHint: Changes take effect when a line using this pool is activated again.
